---
title: "InstaPrism Deconvolution Using PBCA Reference"
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(InstaPrism)
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
```

# Paths

```{r paths}
BASE_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Immune_infiltration_BC_Atlas"

OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "InstaPrism_PBCA_reference")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

BULK_TPM_FILE <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/Max_TPM/tpm_matrix_pILC.txt"

PBCA_REF_FILE <- file.path(
  BASE_DIR,
  "PBCA_InstaPrism_reference.Rds"
)
```

# Load InstaPrism reference

```{r load-reference}
refPhi_obj <- readRDS(PBCA_REF_FILE)

cat("Reference object class:\n")
print(class(refPhi_obj))

cat("\nReference matrix dimensions:\n")
print(dim(refPhi_obj@phi.cs))

cat("\nReference cell types:\n")
print(names(refPhi_obj@map))

cat("\nNumber of cell states per cell type:\n")
print(sapply(refPhi_obj@map, length))
```

# Read pILC TPM matrix

```{r read-bulk}
bulk_df <- fread(BULK_TPM_FILE, data.table = FALSE)

colnames(bulk_df)[1] <- "Gene"
bulk_df$Gene <- as.character(bulk_df$Gene)

# Collapse duplicated genes by mean TPM, if any
bulk_df <- bulk_df %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")

bulk_expr <- as.data.frame(bulk_df)
rownames(bulk_expr) <- bulk_expr$Gene
bulk_expr$Gene <- NULL

bulk_expr <- as.matrix(bulk_expr)
bulk_expr[is.na(bulk_expr)] <- 0
bulk_expr[bulk_expr < 0] <- 0

cat("Bulk TPM dimensions:\n")
print(dim(bulk_expr))

bulk_expr[1:5, 1:min(5, ncol(bulk_expr))]
```

# Match genes between bulk and reference

```{r match-genes}
ref_genes <- rownames(refPhi_obj@phi.cs)
bulk_genes <- rownames(bulk_expr)

common_genes <- intersect(ref_genes, bulk_genes)

cat("Reference genes:", length(ref_genes), "\n")
cat("Bulk genes:", length(bulk_genes), "\n")
cat("Common genes:", length(common_genes), "\n")

if (length(common_genes) < 10000) {
  warning("Low gene overlap. Please check gene symbols.")
}

bulk_expr_use <- bulk_expr[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

refPhi_use <- refPhi_obj
phi_use <- refPhi_obj@phi.cs[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Re-normalize reference columns after gene filtering
phi_colsum <- colSums(phi_use)
phi_use <- sweep(phi_use, 2, phi_colsum, FUN = "/")
phi_use[!is.finite(phi_use)] <- 1e-8

refPhi_use@phi.cs <- phi_use

cat("\nFinal bulk matrix:\n")
print(dim(bulk_expr_use))

cat("\nFinal reference phi matrix:\n")
print(dim(refPhi_use@phi.cs))

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    Metric = c("Reference genes", "Bulk genes", "Common genes", "Bulk samples", "Reference cell states", "Reference cell types"),
    N = c(
      length(ref_genes),
      length(bulk_genes),
      length(common_genes),
      ncol(bulk_expr_use),
      ncol(refPhi_use@phi.cs),
      length(refPhi_use@map)
    )
  ),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "PBCA_InstaPrism_input_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Run InstaPrism

```{r run-instaprism}
deconv_res <- InstaPrism(
  bulk_Expr = bulk_expr_use,
  refPhi_cs = refPhi_use
)

saveRDS(
  deconv_res,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_deconv_result.rds")
)
```

# Extract cell-type fractions

```{r extract-fractions}
estimated_frac <- t(deconv_res@Post.ini.ct@theta)

estimated_frac <- as.data.frame(estimated_frac)
estimated_frac$Sample_ID <- rownames(estimated_frac)
estimated_frac <- estimated_frac %>% relocate(Sample_ID)

write.csv(
  estimated_frac,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_cell_fractions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

estimated_frac[1:min(5, nrow(estimated_frac)), ]
```

# Add immune/stromal/tumor summary

```{r summary}
immune_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "CD8+ T Cells",
    "CD4+ T Cells",
    "Regulatory T Cells",
    "NK Cells",
    "B Cells",
    "Plasma Cells",
    "Macrophages",
    "Monocytes",
    "Dendritic Cells",
    "MDSCs",
    "Mast Cells",
    "Neutrophils"
  ),
  colnames(estimated_frac)
)

stromal_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "Fibroblasts",
    "Perivascular-like (PVL) Cells",
    "Endothelial Cells"
  ),
  colnames(estimated_frac)
)

epithelial_cols <- intersect(
  c(
    "Cancer Epithelial Cells",
    "Epithelial Cells",
    "Myoepithelial Cells"
  ),
  colnames(estimated_frac)
)

summary_df <- estimated_frac %>%
  mutate(
    Immune_Fraction = rowSums(across(all_of(immune_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    Stromal_Fraction = rowSums(across(all_of(stromal_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    Epithelial_Fraction = rowSums(across(all_of(epithelial_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

write.csv(
  summary_df,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_fraction_with_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

summary_df %>%
  arrange(desc(Immune_Fraction)) %>%
  head(10)
```

# Stacked barplot

```{r stacked-barplot, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
frac_long <- estimated_frac %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sample_ID,
    names_to = "Cell_Type",
    values_to = "Fraction"
  )

p_stack <- ggplot(
  frac_long,
  aes(x = Sample_ID, y = Fraction, fill = Cell_Type)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "pILC deconvolution using InstaPrism PBCA reference",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Estimated cell fraction",
    fill = "Cell type"
  )

p_stack

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_stacked_barplot.pdf"),
  plot = p_stack,
  width = 13,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_stacked_barplot.png"),
  plot = p_stack,
  width = 13,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
frac_mat <- estimated_frac
rownames(frac_mat) <- frac_mat$Sample_ID
frac_mat$Sample_ID <- NULL

frac_mat <- as.matrix(frac_mat)
mode(frac_mat) <- "numeric"
frac_mat[!is.finite(frac_mat)] <- 0

frac_mat_t <- t(frac_mat)

row_sd <- apply(frac_mat_t, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
frac_mat_t_plot <- frac_mat_t[row_sd > 0, , drop = FALSE]

pdf(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_fraction_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 8
)

pheatmap(
  frac_mat_t_plot,
  scale = "row",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "InstaPrism PBCA deconvolution fractions"
)

dev.off()

png(
  filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_fraction_heatmap.png"),
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

pheatmap(
  frac_mat_t_plot,
  scale = "row",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "InstaPrism PBCA deconvolution fractions"
)

dev.off()

pheatmap(
  frac_mat_t_plot,
  scale = "row",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  main = "InstaPrism PBCA deconvolution fractions"
)
```

# Total immune fraction plot

```{r immune-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
p_immune <- ggplot(
  summary_df,
  aes(x = reorder(Sample_ID, Immune_Fraction), y = Immune_Fraction)
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated total immune fraction from InstaPrism PBCA reference",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Immune fraction"
  )

p_immune

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_total_immune_fraction.pdf"),
  plot = p_immune,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, "pILC_InstaPrism_PBCA_total_immune_fraction.png"),
  plot = p_immune,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
